questions.question: Does assembled observable evidence satisfy AC-VM-3: Canonical browser authorization uses the selected profile even with omitted resource; Google callback and cookie origin remain canonical; owner/client approval, redirect and issuer error checks apply to both paths.
Are invalid requests bounded and rejected without exposing credentials?
Are profile validation, transaction binding and HTTP selection owned once through typed seams?
Do behavioral matrices discriminate wrong-profile use and canonical browser composition?
Are Host/Origin/CSRF/PKCE/owner/approval and resource checks preserved for both profiles?
Are local HTTP and live-client limitations documented without claiming deployment success?
